boundaries:
Original allied caller, AI, walking, physical attacks and first NPC death.

Input is the separately captured completed introduction and first infantry
event. No AI decision, movement, combat, event condition or RNG is replaced.
Raster/window/audio/wait operations are explicit presentation boundaries.
Stops at the enemy-turn banner before enemy maintenance or decisions.
 Enemy-entry mode also executes the original enemy banner (explicit 640x440 client rectangle, raster/font/OS boundaries), action-flag reset and event selector. It then invokes original opcode-76/79 handlers in the selected source event order, executing original opcode-20 dialogue focus and capturing the text-window boundary, and stops before opcode 50. Maintenance and enemy AI have not run. This command-level continuation does not claim original dialogue rasterization or its interpreter dispatcher.

speeches.text:
看起来好像赶上了。
不过在这种寡不敌众的情况下，
此地官军好像也陷入苦战。

咱们应该趁势里外夹攻，
不过我军兵力还是少了点……。

二哥你就会穷担心…
我一个人就能应付他们了。

我们可不能丢下官军不管，
从背后抄过去直捣鹿砦吧。
冲啊！
